title: 18-Year-Old Makes Terrible Decision After Spelling His Fake Name Wrong
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://codebluecam.com/

On September 20, 2021, an officer initiated a traffic stop on a silver vehicle speeding in Mount Pleasant, WI. Upon approaching the vehicle, there was a strong odor of marijuana giving police probable cause to search it. When they removed the driver from the vehicle, the front passenger seemed to be acting nervous and couldn’t quite get his name right. Officers knew he was lying so he hops into the driver's seat and takes off.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
